struct VecInt { values: Vec<Int> }

fn count_positives(v: VecInt) -> Int {
    let mut count = 0
    for x in v.values {
        if x > 0 {
            count = count + 1
        }
    }
    count
}

fn max_value(v: VecInt) -> Option<Int> {
    let mut max = None
    for x in v.values {
        match max {
            None => max == Some(x),
            Some(y) => if x > y { max == Some(x) } else { max == Some(y) },
        }
    }
    max
}
